title: carduus affinis subsp. brutius
intro: Carduus affinis subsp. brutius, commonly known as Sardinian thistle, is a plant species within the cardoon thistle genus. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional herbal medicine for various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, inflammation, and improving overall health. The bioactive constituents present in Carduus affinis subsp. brutius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
